# OSG — M3 Business Rules Catalog v0.3

Status: canonical pre-v1 candidate
Date: 2026-09-15

This version supersedes v0.2 for current pre-v1 semantics.

## A. Universal system rules

**BR-SYS-001** Stable business IDs are UUIDv7 generated by shared application ID layer.

**BR-SYS-002** Organization is tenant boundary; tenant context is mandatory for tenant-owned operations.

**BR-SYS-003** Same-tenant does not imply same-Property. Property-context integrity is independently enforced.

**BR-SYS-004** Derived projections/KPI/dashboard fields are never authoritative write sources.

**BR-SYS-005** Final historical facts use reversal/correction/new event, not destructive overwrite.

**BR-SYS-006** Critical mutations record actor/source/time/correlation and generate audit/domain evidence as applicable.

**BR-SYS-007** Operational timestamps are stored as timestamptz; Property timezone governs local hospitality semantics.

**BR-SYS-008** A retryable external/API command has idempotency identity distinct from aggregate row_version.

## B. Property / Digital Twin

**BR-PROP-001** Unit belongs to exactly one Property.

**BR-PROP-002** UnitType is category; Unit is physical accommodation instance.

**BR-PROP-003** Unit lifecycle is PLANNED → ACTIVE → RETIRED. Temporary OOS is not lifecycle.

**BR-PROP-004** Temporary unavailability is represented by time-bounded AvailabilityBlock.

**BR-PROP-005** AvailabilityBlock explicitly states sellability, operations and guest impact.

**BR-PROP-006** Physical capacity, raw sellable capacity and effective commercial capacity are distinct.

**BR-PROP-007** PropertyStayPolicy is versioned and active validity ranges may not overlap.

**BR-PROP-008** Historical stay policy determines check-in/out/readiness/overnight anchor for that date.

## C. Reservation / Stay / Accommodation night

**BR-STAY-001** Reservation is commercial commitment; Stay is execution.

**BR-STAY-002** Reservation plan dates are not overwritten by actual check-in/out.

**BR-STAY-003** Relocation creates a new StaySegment; prior segment remains historical.

**BR-STAY-004** Active StaySegments for one Unit may not overlap.

**BR-STAY-005** Commercial Accommodation Night is distinct from physical StaySegment overlap.

**BR-STAY-006** Final historical commercial night requires an executed Stay, not merely confirmed Reservation.

**BR-STAY-007** Night D is attributed to Unit hosting versioned overnight anchor on D+1.

**BR-STAY-008** Unresolved overnight attribution creates DataQualityIssue; system does not guess Unit.

**BR-STAY-009** Late checkout does not create a new accommodation night without commercial extension.

**BR-STAY-010** No-show/cancellation fee revenue does not create accommodation night.

**BR-STAY-011** Physical utilization is reported separately from standard commercial Occupancy.

## D. Folio / Charge / Payment / Refund

**BR-COM-001** Charge ≠ Payment ≠ Refund ≠ CashMovement ≠ EconomicEvent.

**BR-COM-002** Folio balance is projection: net final Charges − (gross confirmed Payments − confirmed Refunds).

**BR-COM-003** Release 1 Folio is single-currency.

**BR-COM-004** Payment currency must equal Folio currency.

**BR-COM-005** Refund currency must equal Payment currency; confirmed refunds may not exceed original Payment.

**BR-COM-006** Payment remains historical after Refund; Refund is separate fact.

**BR-COM-007** Final Charge is immutable in material fields.

**BR-COM-008** Charge correction/reversal is new opposite-sign Charge referencing original; original has no mutable REVERSED state.

**BR-COM-009** Cumulative reversing Charges may not exceed original absolute amount.

**BR-COM-010** CLOSED Folio requires balance tolerance ≤ 0.01 and no blocking pending commercial items.

**BR-COM-011** CLOSED Folio reopen requires controlled privileged workflow and audit.

**BR-COM-012** PaymentAllocation may not exceed available Payment value.

## E. Services / Resources

**BR-SVC-001** Service is sellable offer; Resource is constrained execution capacity.

**BR-SVC-002** ServiceBooking (plan) ≠ ServiceExecution (actual).

**BR-SVC-003** ResourceReservation effective window includes preparation/reset buffers.

**BR-SVC-004** Exclusive Resource intervals cannot overlap.

**BR-SVC-005** Capacity Resource sum under lock may not exceed Resource.capacity.

**BR-SVC-006** HELD capacity expires according to hold policy; expired hold ceases consuming capacity.

**BR-SVC-007** Package decomposes to measurable accommodation/service/fee/discount components.

## F. Operations

**BR-OPS-001** Turnover is process; Task is unit of work.

**BR-OPS-002** Stay.CheckedOut may asynchronously create Turnover through outbox automation.

**BR-OPS-003** READY state requires configured required work/inspection conditions.

**BR-OPS-004** Incident is adverse event, not generic Task.

**BR-OPS-005** CRITICAL/safety Incident may synchronously create block when partial completion would be unsafe.

**BR-OPS-006** Incident/AvailabilityBlock overlap with existing Reservation/Stay creates explicit conflict workflow, not silent cancellation/reassignment.

## G. Financial Truth

**BR-FT-001** FinancialDocument, CashMovement, EconomicEvent and Allocation remain independent truths.

**BR-FT-002** Accounting classification never automatically owns OSG economic allocation.

**BR-FT-003** Cash transfer between accounts is not revenue/cost solely because money moved.

**BR-FT-004** POSTED EconomicEvent must be fully allocated within currency tolerance.

**BR-FT-005** POSTED EconomicEvent and Allocation set are immutable in place.

**BR-FT-006** `effect_direction=NORMAL/REVERSAL` changes polarity while preserving Allocation economic category.

**BR-FT-007** CAPEX/OPEX/NON_BUSINESS classification belongs to Allocation, so lines of one invoice may differ.

**BR-FT-008** Manual/estimated Allocation requires rationale and confidence.

**BR-FT-009** paid_by and economic_bearer are independent.

**BR-FT-010** SettlementEntry originates from explicit economic source; applications cannot exceed open amount.

**BR-FT-011** Every REVIEWED/POSTED EconomicEvent belongs to exactly one matching FinancialPeriod.

**BR-FT-012** FinancialPeriod ranges do not overlap inside one scope.

**BR-FT-013** HARD_CLOSED period cannot be rewritten in place.

**BR-FT-014** Prior-period correction is recognized in allowed current period with explicit historical-period relation and reason unless controlled reopen is approved.

**BR-FT-015** Property-owned POSTED economics use Property reporting currency in Release 1.

**BR-FT-016** Economic result is Allocation-driven; FinancialDocument total and CashMovement are not substituted.

## H. Guest identity / privacy

**BR-GST-001** Guest identity merge is auditable canonicalization, not destructive record deletion.

**BR-GST-002** Historical Reservation/Stay provenance may retain original GuestProfile reference.

**BR-GST-003** Active GuestProfile alias is one-level/flattened; cycles and chains are forbidden.

**BR-GST-004** Weak fuzzy/name-only similarity cannot silently merge guests.

**BR-GST-005** Marketing consent events remain source/time/version specific and are not blindly merged as one boolean.

**BR-PRV-001** Minimum necessary personal data only.

**BR-PRV-002** Marketing consent is independent of accommodation-service legal/contract basis.

## I. Security / permissions

**BR-SEC-001** Backend/domain layer enforces permissions; UI hiding is not authorization.

**BR-SEC-002** RoleAssignment is scope-aware.

**BR-SEC-003** Sensitive guest/financial fields use field-level filtering where role-level entity read is too broad.

**BR-SEC-004** AI effective permission = user permission ∩ AI allowed actions.

**BR-SEC-005** High-risk approval can require creator ≠ approver.

**BR-SEC-006** Runtime tenant scope failure is fail-closed.

## J. Integrations / automation

**BR-INT-001** External provider schema is translated through adapter to canonical OSG contract.

**BR-INT-002** Every external record preserves provenance and stable external identity where available.

**BR-INT-003** External/import processing is idempotent under retries/replay/concurrency.

**BR-INT-004** Field ownership policy prevents external source from silently overwriting OSG-owned truth.

**BR-AUT-001** DomainEvent describes something that happened; Automation reacts but does not rewrite event history.

**BR-AUT-002** Cross-aggregate event delivery uses transactional outbox when state/event atomicity matters.

**BR-AUT-003** Automation execution is idempotent by rule + trigger event + action key.

## K. Metrics / Semantic Layer

**BR-MET-001** Metric has code, version, grain, time semantics, source facts and explainability.

**BR-MET-002** Formula semantic change creates new metric version.

**BR-MET-003** Occupancy uses Commercial Accommodation Night; physical utilization is separate.

**BR-MET-004** ADR uses accommodation revenue / commercial accommodation nights.

**BR-MET-005** RevPAR/TRevPAR use effective commercial capacity; raw sellable capacity remains visible.

**BR-MET-006** Cash Change is never labeled profit/economic result.

**BR-MET-007** Estimates/opportunity cost cannot be presented as actual historical loss.

**BR-MET-008** Material KPI exposes data confidence and Why-this-number chain.

## L. Agent governance

**BR-AI-001** READ MANY / WRITE ONE.

**BR-AI-002** Artifact has one active write owner.

**BR-AI-003** Cross-domain change requires affected-domain review.

**BR-AI-004** L3 architecture decision requires ADR.

**BR-AI-005** Agent cannot bypass domain guard/error to force success.

## M. Freeze rule

No Schema v1 FINAL while any P0 executable gate in current Gap Register remains unproven.
